howToPlay: Right hand leaps up a major 6th — D4 to B4. Practise the jump silently first: eyes find B4 before the hand leaves D4, then add sound once the distance feels automatic.
Syncopation — D4, B4, G4 land between the beats. Tap a steady pulse with one hand and say the rhythm out loud before playing it.

practiceNotes: Slow practice: one chunk clean, then add the next. Never rush the join.
